after: setRunProperties accepts an optional characterStyle. A string sets each covered run's w:rStyle, null removes it, and omission keeps today's behavior. Tracked writes keep the prior reference in the existing w:rPrChange record.
reason: The optional field lowers to existing run-property node writes and the existing tracked formatting record. Collaboration replicates the resulting run property nodes; the shared journal, codecs, operation kinds, and WordprocessingML shapes do not change.
